newsitem.title: GERMANY: Handelsblatt indicator edges higher in August.
newsitem.headline: Handelsblatt indicator edges higher in August.

text.p: The Handelsblatt leading economic indicator index for west Germany rose 0.1 percentage point from a month ago to 2.3 percent at the start of August, with industrial firms increasingly confident about the future.

But Handelsblatt, in an article in its Monday edition, warned the impact of the climbing dollar, which for instance could raise worries of tighter monetary policy, has not yet been fully felt in the index.
The index now is 1.8 percentage points higher than it was a year ago.
The Handelsblatt indicator is based on economic reports including the Ifo business sentiment index, and industrial and construction orders.
